items.title: 如何在 GTA 6 中解锁布鲁克斯造船厂保险箱
items.summary: And find a new gun, lots of pills and plenty of cash.

content.v: GTA 6 drops you into Chapter 2 desperate for cash, but you'll quickly find a few opportunities to make a quick buck if you don't mind trying to outrun bullets. One of the ways that you can get flush quickly is by visiting Brooks Boatworks , a criminal enterprise that's full of pills, cash and explosives. You'll also find a safe in need of a code, which I can help you find.

A word of warning, though: the boatworks is heaving with gun-toting crooks, and getting into a big firefight is just going to bring the cops down on you. Stealth is absolutely a good choice here, but I also recommend going in heavily armed. You can complete the heist just with Lucia, but it's going to be tougher.
Brooks Boatworks location
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tYyCzDiz86GJTRredw4WLe-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/iEZJea26QRTLKtpjViqiym-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5ERiCVM7qyWenAzvhdukym-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eGAKfXiDP8J6J6oViCpiwm-1920-80.jpg

You can find Brooks Boatworks in the north of Port Gellhorn , just to the right of the larger bridge. When you get near the main gate, guards will start threatening you. Even if you take them out, you're not getting in that way.

Instead, head to the right where there's an unlocked gate. You'll still need to get through the fence to get into the boatworks, but that's simple. Right in front of you when you come through the gate you'll find a big gap in the fence. Just walk through it. This also gives you a decent view of the boatworks. If you want to go in loud, this is a great place to take out some goons with a long-ranged weapon.
Brooks Boatworks safe code location
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tCdDe95zFbzMbhEnAgKBUm-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Zcwjg23Rf8v2qY3nWSPrXm-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/EGiMfUodLLMzbkrJ7p7bfm-1920-80.jpg

Near where you got through the fence, you'll find the smallest building in the compound. This should be your first port of call. Inside you'll find cash, medicine and a unique carbine— the Clunker . It's a solid all-rounder. Once you grab your new toy, check out the map on the wall behind it. Not only will you find the code for the boatworks safe, you'll find other safe codes as well.
Looking at the map will save the codes, so now you know 6823 is the magic number .
Brooks Boatworks safe location
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/G4wcfx3VUcHrz9Zzu8Dtym-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/D2t7xpNhbWuw8Lh3Rekxym-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rNRFffSdy9aALjERpoiNXm-1920-80.jpg

You'll find the safe inside the warehouse—it's the largest building, so you can't miss it. There are lots of ways to get inside the warehouse, but I recommend the sneaky route. On the right side of the warehouse, you'll find a way up onto the roof . Once you get up, just climb over it and you'll find an opening that lets you drop in from above.

Now you're at the top of the warehouse, but you'll need to go down to find the room with the safe. Head down, but stick to the side you entered from, and you'll find a room with a pool table and some goons —this is where you'll find the safe.
Just pop in the code 6823 and grab the cash.
Don't leave Brooks Boatworks just yet
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Zcwjg23Rf8v2qY3nWSPrXm-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SxCyoH9wxdBN4e8ZShhyTm-1920-80.jpg

If you're not close to death or being hounded by cops yet, take some time to explore the rest of the compound. There's cash and pills just scattered all over the place, and make sure to grab all the explosive weaponry, especially the launcher that's just chilling on the top floor , above the room with the safe.

Once you've cleared the warehouse, you'll find yet another building to the west. There's more to find here, including another safe . This one can be broken into without a code, thankfully. Now you can bounce and go on a shopping spree!

items.title: 失散20年双胞胎不找亲生父母 称养恩大于生恩
items.summary: 近日，博主姐姐“Sum”（夏天）和妹妹“阿Co”（小罗）发布“失散20年双胞胎生日重逢”的视频引发关注。由于此事过于巧合，有网友怀…

content.v: 据第一现场报道，近日，博主姐姐“Sum”（夏天）和妹妹“阿Co”（小罗）发布“失散20年双胞胎生日重逢”的视频引发关注。由于此事过于巧合，有网友怀疑是剧本。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261121_zy_red_164_16/179.jpg
记者采访双胞胎姐妹，妹妹小罗告诉记者，她们在2006年农历9月份出生，出生十几天便被生父母送养。妹妹在四川达州、姐姐在四川广安长大，两姐妹先后来到深圳生活：“今年10月30日，堂哥发现网上有一个女孩长得和我很像，当天晚上就联系了双方养父母，证实了都是抱养的。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261121_zy_red_164_16/1213.jpg
据姐姐小夏所说，当年她的亲生父母生了大姐、二姐，第三胎就是她和小罗（双胞胎）。她的养父母在小区里认识了亲生父母，抱养了她，妹妹也差不多时间被另一个家庭抱走，从此两姐妹就分开了。还有两个姐姐在原生家庭，从没见过。两人已经约定，过年互相上门走亲戚。姐妹俩达成共识：养恩大于生恩。长久陪伴的养育之情，远比血缘更加珍贵。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261121_zy_red_164_16/1374.jpg

items.title: 当你等待《上古卷轴 6：哨兵》时，你应该玩一下“污染圣杯”
items.summary: They do make them like they used to.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ckZUwfxbakq5yXMJMfSmBW-1920-80.png

Welcome to Dungeon Master , PC Gamer's regular RPG column, where Online Editor Fraser Brown delves into PC gaming's most beloved and enduring genre. Grab a seat in our badly-lit tavern and please ignore the goblin puke.

I will probably be in the ground when Bethesda finally releases The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel —which is kind of liberating. I have hype immunity. But what's even more liberating is the fact that there's already an RPG that does everything I want from an Elder Scrolls game—2025's Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avelon.

Tainted Grail is unabashedly created in the mould of The Elder Scrolls, in that it is a primarily first-person fantasy RPG where flexibility is its superpower. You chart your own course and effectively construct your class, enhancing skills by using them as much as possible. But it is not merely the Elder Scrolls we have at home—it captures the very best that this kind of RPG can offer, and in some ways manages to outdo Bethesda.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tpAew3T94QUpH9NQmoJh8k-1920-80.jpg

This is apparent right from the get-go. In classic Elder Scrolls form, Tainted Grail begins with you banged up in a facility that incarcerates and studies unfortunates afflicted with a magical plague, of which you are one. Follow the critical path and you will meet a new friend, get in some tough fights and then escape.
By the time I finally escaped the island and began my adventure proper, I already knew this RPG was special.

But this island asylum is big. Really big. It's full of locked doors, hidden rooms, large spaces ripe for some big brawls, a subterranean area waiting to be delved into, oodles of lore—there are hours of rooting around to be done. So I ignored the critical path, had a big old wander, and by the time I finally escaped the island and began my adventure proper, I already knew this RPG was special.

While Tainted Grail is full of bespoke quests sending you off into the open world on countless adventures, these are really just designed to get you out the door so you can stumble upon something cool—a new enemy that will utterly destroy you, a powerful weapon hidden in a crypt, an eccentric immortal being who wants to make a deal. The vibe is very TTRPG, which isn't surprising, given that it's based on one.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/45EpfYmfGdywQCt5ZVR97Q-1920-80.png

And these adventures are actually dangerous. Deadly, even. The villains of Tainted Grail hit hard, and early on you will feel horrifyingly vulnerable. Basic bandits and skeletons can easily spell your doom. And if you stay out at night, you're screwed. Avelon is a miserable, cruel place, cursed and plagued, and you will struggle.

Developer Questline didn't simply up the lethality and call it a day, though. Tainted Grail, unlike The Elder Scrolls, actually has a quality combat system that falls firmly into the skill-based category. It's no Dark Souls, but it's more Dark Souls than Skyrim. So that increased level of challenge feels earned because of the tools you have available to you, and the range of combat styles you can develop.

With all the options you have at your disposal—which has been further enhanced by DLC additions, letting you, for example, go through this Arthurian fantasy RPG as a kung-fu master—it can be hard to commit to a build. I've been spellblading it up, with my alchemical skills helping to shore up my weaknesses, but every time I encounter a new piece of gear I wonder what else I could create. But you do need to commit eventually. This isn't a game for a jack of all trades.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Yq4wUNkJaKskbJoRpQvCC8-1920-80.jpg

While Bethesda is more deft at crafting believable, reactive lands, Tainted Grail's world design also deserves its flowers. It's a smaller space, divided into three main areas, and while you can absolutely muck around for hundreds of hours, you can experience most of what it has to offer in 50. But what you'll experience in those 50 hours is so much more meticulously designed, with Questline getting so much out of each location.
It's a game full of aesthetic juxtapositions.

It's a looker, too. What it lacks in fidelity it more than makes up for in the art design department, and it's another place where Dark Souls rears its gorgeously hideous head. Tainted Grail finds beauty in the grim misery of its fantastical post-apocalyptic realm. It's a game full of aesthetic juxtapositions—the arboreal and the horrific, the grounded and alien. Avelon is delightfully strange, and that makes exploration all the more thrilling.

As games grow ever larger and more bloated, my appreciation for richer, better-scoped worlds like Avalon only grows. And this does not indicate a dearth of ambition on Questline's part. Tainted Grail is a complex, elaborate game that will happily devour your days and keep showing you new things.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SLjqUxpFeaHZpNj9pcJ3F-1920-80.jpg

Clearly people want this—Tainted Grail has done very well for itself, garnering more than 20,000 user reviews on Steam , where its rating sits at Very Positive. It's a reassuring reminder that you do not need a gargantuan studio and big publisher money to make a quality RPG in the Elder Scrolls style.

We don't know how many people are working on Sentinel right now, but we can expect the number to be large. Skyrim had around 100 people working on it, and with Starfield that jumped to more than 400. Tainted Grail was made by 50 people. That's quite the achievement.

So if you're craving a side-quest-heavy sandbox RPG with plenty of sword fights and spellflinging, Tainted Grail should absolutely be your next port of call. And the good news is that there's a demo . No excuses. Go play it.

items.title: GTA 6 Transgressor 地点：如何修复 Wyman 的第一辆车
items.summary: Find cars for Wyman to fix the 67' Sirius Transgressor.

content.v: You'll be able to start looking for GTA 6 Transgressor locations after you complete the Thrillbillies mission in Chapter 2 and collect the Vapid Dominator from Wyman (if you have the Ultimate Edition , that is).

He'll text to ask for help finding old wrecked Transgressors he can use to restore the classic car, which you'll then get to drive. There are three of these junks located around Port Gellhorn which you'll have to scan with the Waink It app.
North of Sarena's Bargain Store

The first wrecked Transgressor you can find is in a trailer park north of Sarena's Bargain Store in the middle of Port Gellhorn (you might have to zoom in to see the store). Head north, cross the road, and jump over the wall to find it there.
Opposite the Stash House

The second wrecked Transgressor is further north in the garage of the house opposite the Kolt & Associate's Stash House robbery (there's a metal sunflower standing in the garden, which makes it easier to recognise.) It's also to the east of Brook's Boatworks and the west of Wasteland Offroad. Head around the side of the house via the driveway to find the car in an open garage at the back.
Behind Dirt Merchants

This last one is nice and easy, behind the Dirt Merchants mod shop in the south of Port Gellhorn. Simply head right via the track that leads behind the shop, following the fence on your right and then turn left to find the wreck at the back behind the kind of trailer park area.
Collecting the Transgressor
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/S7jUAVumAufq9SgGfNCEaV-1920-80.jpg

Once you have all three cars scanned, Wyman will take a little time to assemble it, and then call you asking to Buck him some money. Open the app, select the payment requests option, and then pay him the $1,500 for the car. This will give you a quest marker to collect it from his scrapyard.

items.title: 距离《女神异闻录 5 Royal》已经过去七年了，Atlus 表示，《女神异闻录 6》之后的下一款游戏“人们将不必像以前那样等待那么久”
items.summary: "Persona 6 is not the end".

others.title: 《女神异闻录 6》尚未确定日期，但 Atlus 表示你不必等待《女神异闻录 7》那么久
Atlus 不想让你再等 10 年《女神异闻录 7》

content.v: The amount of time it takes to develop games has been growing steadily longer for decades, and Atlus' Persona series is no exception to this rule. While Persona 4 Golden and Persona 5 were separated by four years (long considered standard for game development) it's been seven years since Persona 5 Royal and Persona 6 still doesn’t have a release date—though we did get Metaphor: ReFantazio in between.

Nonetheless, it's an issue that P-Studio is very much aware of, and it was recently addressed by general producer Kazuhisa Wada. In an interview with Sega Samania (via Eurogamer ) Wada stressed that the wait for whatever comes after Persona 6 will be shorter.

"Persona 6 is not the end," Wada explained. "We have been working to make sure that people won't have to wait as long for the next game as they have previously. In order for Persona to grow as an IP, we consider how to live up to people's expectations in terms of creativity and development every day."

Now, we're probably not looking at a dramatic reduction in development time. Wada emphasised that "large-scale RPGs like the Personal series can take five years or more to develop," adding that. "There can be a long time between numbered entries." Yet even if the average timeline was five years, that would be a considerable improvement.

Wada doesn't explain how Atlus plans to speed up development of its games. But there's always one question when developers begin talking about making games quicker—does it involve generative AI? Wada expressed interest in the tech several years ago, stating that it might be useful for "early concept and idea formation" and that the Atlus art team had been "talking about wanting to implement AI." That said, there's been little, if any talk about AI from Atlus since, and there's no evidence at present that Persona 6 uses the tech.

In fact, Atlus hasn't said much about Persona 6 at all since the game was announced earlier this year, though there are rumours that we'll find out more at The Game Awards in a few weeks' time. As for Wada, while he didn't comment on Persona 6 in detail, he did say that Atlus is "creating something better than anything we've made before, and that is hugely satisfying."

items.summary: 据Dexerto报道，一则关于Rockstar新作的旧爆料近日重新引发玩家关注。此前曾提前透露《GTA6》结局细节的匿名爆料者，还声称Rockstar…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212156423125.jpg
据Dexerto报道，一则关于Rockstar新作的旧爆料近日重新引发玩家关注。此前曾提前透露《GTA6》结局细节的匿名爆料者，还声称Rockstar正在开发《黑色洛城2》，续作可能将故事舞台转移至旧金山，并以现实中的十二宫杀手案件为核心。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212157029804.jpg
这则消息最早于2023年出现在GTAForums论坛，由用户Shahanshah转述一名4chan匿名用户的爆料。如今《GTA6》正式推出后，玩家重新翻看这份爆料，发现其中关于游戏结局、杰森与露西亚的关系，以及犯罪档案系统等细节与最终游戏相符，因此有关《黑色洛城2》的说法也再次受到关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212156527024.jpg
按照爆料内容，《黑色洛城2》将不再以1940年代的洛杉矶为背景，而是把故事带到旧金山，并围绕神秘的十二宫杀手展开。爆料者还称，游戏当时仍处于非常早期的开发阶段，预计可能要到2030年才能推出。
此外，Rockstar据称还计划重新启用初代《黑色洛城》标志性的面部扫描技术，并对其进行大幅升级，力求打造更加逼真的角色面部表现。
值得一提的是，Rockstar此前已经收购了曾参与《黑色洛城》重制版开发的Video Games Deluxe工作室，并于2025年将其更名为Rockstar Australia。不过，官方尚未公布该工作室目前正在开发什么项目，也没有正式宣布《黑色洛城2》。

content.v: 《GTA6》发售后，玩家社区流传的多段实机片段显示，游戏中部分NPC面对劫车或无端攻击时会强烈反击，个别NPC在连续受伤后仍会追击玩家。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795268668_496120_jpg_r.jpg
其中一段画面中，Lucia试图将一名NPC拖出车辆，对方随即迎战，在承受大量拳击和一次头部枪击后仍未倒下。另一段劫车画面里，车主先激烈撞击方向盘，随后下车威胁Jason，并试图将他拉出车辆。
还有玩家从高处用狙击枪射击NPC。对方中弹后又遭车辆撞击，并继续受到枪击，却仍向玩家所在位置追来。另一名NPC发现自己遭到瞄准后先作出割喉手势，随后冲向玩家，其间还出现被视频发布者形容为“瞬移到身后”的异常行为。
收录的另一段劫车片段中，车辆后座的猫突然袭击正在驾驶的Jason，之后被他扔出车外。这些案例既可能包含NPC的反击行为设计，也出现了承伤过高、位置跳转等疑似异常现象，目前不能据此认定游戏内所有NPC都具备相同机制。

items.title: R星官方新回应:GTA6是乐观向上的 让你"连接"主角
items.summary: 据GamesRadar+报道，Rockstar叙事高级副总裁Rupert Humphries在采访中谈到《GTA 6》双主角杰森与露西亚的设计思路，称游戏最想让玩…

content.v: 据GamesRadar+报道，Rockstar叙事高级副总裁Rupert Humphries在采访中谈到《GTA 6》双主角杰森与露西亚的设计思路，称游戏最想让玩家感受到的是 “连接” 。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469760.jpg
玩家需要相信并代入杰森与露西亚，陪他们走完这段旅程；两个角色之间的关系本身，也是叙事要传达的重点。
Humphries把当下的现实描述为噪音与压力无处不在，政治、环境、媒体和社交媒体从四面八方涌来，并称“我们都只差两件倒霉事就会彻底崩溃”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469764.jpg
他说，这正是游戏里罪恶都市街头以及雷奥尼达其他地方所呈现的世界：人们被逼向某种疯狂，表现形式从阴谋论等反社会行为、快速致富计划和吸毒习惯不等。
在这一背景下，Rockstar希望把两个玩家能够关心、也能看到自己的角色放在故事中心。Humphries还提到一个想法： 无论你有多坏，当人们在一起而不是独自前行时，或许都会过得更好。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469767.jpg
报道同时指出，《GTA6》对现代生活仍保留乐观看法，这与《给他爱5》总体上愤世嫉俗的世界观有明显不同。

content.v: 据IGN报道，《GTA6》玩家在游戏里翻到一本能读的书，书里写的却是《荒野大镖客2》的旧事，多处提及《荒野大镖客》及其续作，被玩家视为两个系列可能同处一个世界观的最新线索。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469738.jpg
报道称，相关内容由X用户GameRoll分享。书中以一位原创角色的视角，记述枪手弗拉科·埃尔南德斯的生死：他在雪地里发现埃尔南德斯的尸体，位置正是《荒野大镖客2》相关任务中玩家留下对方的地方；书中还写到埃尔南德斯额头正中有一个弹孔，并提及多处游戏地名。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469739.jpg
对熟悉Rockstar作品的玩家来说，这类细节的分量在于它把《荒野大镖客》系列放到了《GTA》时间线的更早位置。报道同时提到，此前玩家已在《GTA6》中发现亚瑟·摩根，而《GTAOnline》初版角色创建器也曾允许玩家与约翰·马斯顿共享基因。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469740.jpg
不过，这仍属于玩家发现与媒体解读，Rockstar并未就此作出官方说明。报道也指出，书中内容并不足以确认杰森是亚瑟·摩根的后裔之类的具体设定。
社区反应并不一致。有玩家在社交平台表示乐见两个世界观打通，认为这让整个宇宙显得更大；也有玩家提出疑问：在《荒野大镖客2》里部分州和城市用的是真实名称，而《GTA》系列惯用虚构地名，两套命名如何自洽仍需解释。

items.title: 《GTA6》PC版移植已悄然推进：40款显卡参与测试，连Steam Deck都能跑?
items.summary: 《GTA6》PC版可能比玩家想象中来得更快。尽管R星目前尚未公布PC版的正式消息，但一群民间开发者已经开始尝试将PS5版游戏移植到Windows平台。据相关项目的测试记录显示，目前已有40款不同的显卡参与兼容性测试，甚至

content.v: 《GTA6》PC版可能比玩家想象中来得更快。尽管R星目前尚未公布PC版的正式消息，但一群民间开发者已经开始尝试将PS5版游戏移植到Windows平台。据相关项目的测试记录显示，目前已有40款不同的显卡参与兼容性测试，甚至包括Steam Deck使用的硬件。
这项名为AnyPS5的开源项目，旨在将PS5游戏转换为可以在Windows系统上运行的原生程序，而不是通过传统模拟器运行游戏。该项目目前在GitHub上已经获得约5.77万颗星，开发者正在持续完善PS5游戏代码向Windows平台的转换能力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795258766_355592_jpg_r.jpg
从项目提交记录来看，参与测试的显卡涵盖了英伟达、AMD以及英特尔多个系列，其中RTX 4090出现的频率最高，其次是RX 6700XT和RTX3060。值得注意的是，RTX 3060恰好也是此前泄露的《GTA6》PC版最低显卡配置之一。此外，测试名单还包括Radeon860M、Radeon660M以及Intel UHD770等集成显卡，意味着开发者正在尝试让游戏兼容更多不同级别的硬件。

更令人惊讶的是，该项目的开发进度相当迅速。近期提交记录显示，过去400次代码提交中，有82次标注了Claude AI的共同编写信息，涉及Sonnet、Opus等模型，部分代码甚至在约15小时内集中完成。项目中的着色器重编译器负责将PS5使用的图形代码转换为Vulkan接口，从而让游戏能够在NVIDIA和AMD显卡上运行。据开发者透露，该项目的着色器兼容率已经从几个月前的52%提升至100%，目前已有游戏能够正常运行，甚至《漫威金刚狼》也已经可以启动并显示游戏Logo。
目前，真正阻碍《GTA6》PC版移植的关键因素，可能只剩下获取完整且适配最新PS5固件的游戏文件。此前有黑客声称在《GTA6》发售前两天已经提取到相关文件，但目前尚未公开具体内容，因此这项移植工作仍缺少最关键的游戏资源。
虽然这些测试并不意味着《GTA6》已经能够在PC上完整运行，但AI辅助开发正在显著加快民间移植项目的进度。考虑到R星此前一直被认为计划在2027年初推出PC版，如果第三方移植项目继续以目前的速度推进，玩家或许不需要等待官方版本，就有机会提前在PC上体验这款游戏。不过，未经授权的移植仍存在稳定性、性能和版权方面的问题，距离真正可玩的完整版本还有多远，目前仍是未知数。

others.title: 《GTA6》用户评分仅5.4！真实体验遭质疑

content.v: 《GTA6》发售后，Metacritic用户评分一度落在5.4分左右，与此前媒体端的高分预期形成明显落差。短时间内出现大量低分评价，部分玩家与观察者质疑其中存在集中刷分行为。
编辑观点： 用户评分与媒体评分长期存在差异，尤其在高话题作品上更为显著。分数本身受参与人群结构、情绪传导与平台机制共同影响。最终判断游戏品质，仍需结合实际游玩时长、后续更新与长期口碑，而非单一时间点的用户均分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211456185737.jpg
《GTA6》发售之后，一场围绕评分的争论已经在玩家社区全面铺开。Metacritic上本作的用户评分一度跌至5.4分，和媒体评测给出的顶级高分形成刺眼的落差。海量短时间集中涌出的低分评价，直接撕裂玩家社群，形成了“真实游玩反馈”与“恶意差评轰炸”两种完全对立的解读。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211456261821.jpg
站在刷分论这边的玩家表示，这次的评分曲线异常，大量差评集中在发售初期短时间发布，不少评价文字空洞、情绪先行，并没有详细的游玩体验描述，和过往现象级大作上线时遭遇的集中刷分特征高度相似。在他们看来，这份低分并不能代表真正打通游戏、深度体验玩家的想法。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211456327974.jpg
而另一部分玩家并不认同全部归罪于刷分。他们提出，低分里藏着实打实的游玩争议：剧情节奏、人物塑造、还有部分场景的技术表现，都成了玩家吐槽的靶子。在这一派观点里，5.4分正是玩家群体内部巨大分歧的直接体现，不能简单粗暴将所有负面评价全部视作外部攻击。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211456373453.jpg
媒体评分和用户评分本就属于两套评价体系，这种两极反差在顶级话题大作身上早已屡见不鲜。用户均分本身很容易受到参与打分人群构成、首发舆论情绪、平台打分规则的多重干扰，单一时间节点的数字无法一锤定音判定游戏好坏。
想要看清《GTA6》真正的品质，还是要等待热度降温，结合玩家长时间游玩后的感受、后续官方更新，观察口碑长期走向。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211456435061.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 最奇怪的牛告诉你为什么应该尽早暂停故事来探索其广阔的地图
items.summary: I escaped GTA 6's starting neighborhood to explore the wider world, and you'll never believe what happened wit

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/gta-6-cow-story-blogroll-1795184902367.jpg
Warning: this story features spoilers for an optional side activity.
"Save me."

Those two chilling words were so soft I wondered if I'd heard them correctly – after all, the only souls in this orchard were me and Tootsie, an escaped cow draped in red cloth with a rosette stuck to her forehead.

But no, I had heard them, and I turned them over in my head as I led Tootsie back along her rampaging path, through fallen fruit, over a busted wooden fence, and to her owner, a dairy farmer I'd found on the side of the road, flustered and crying about his prized $2 million show cow.

I was still processing those two words as we approached the farmer's trailer, and when he told me that tonight, a fan had paid to watch a private Tootsie mud bath, I knew what I had to do. I shooed her to her freedom – "Go, run! Live your best life!" – and she galloped, ribbons fluttering, hooves pounding into the distance. To freedom rather than a busy highway, I hoped.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/gta-6-cow-story-run-1795183333729.jpg
I was Jason, the good Samaritan (if you ignore the part where I then provoked the farmer to start a fight, knocked him out cold, stamped on his limp body and stole the $500 in his pocket).

This was about six hours into Rockstar's latest masterpiece . For a game as vast and open as GTA 6 , I found the opening strangely claustrophobic – to begin, the giant map of Leonida is shrouded in fog apart from the sliver of the Florida Keys where Jason lives and some surrounding swamp land. Key Lento is so dense with activities, shops, missions, and random encounters, not to mention the constant distraction of pottering around Jason's waterside house, that I felt overwhelmed by it all. And so, perhaps earlier than the game wanted me to, I pointed Jason's red pickup north and started driving.
What I found was that GTA 6's open world holds delights that you can enjoy no matter where you are in the main story.

I slipped west of Vice City, turning off the highway's spiralling spaghetti junctions near Buckskin Swamp. Soon I parked up at Emerald Springs, a nature reserve with pristine boardwalks and stands selling orange juice and doughnuts. I plodded the planks, eating a sandwich from the Black Bear Deli. I studied some ducks, beat up an entitled British tourist, stole a bike, and pedalled back to my car.

I had hoped to find something crafted and scripted, but the fact that I could still have fun in a place with ostensibly nothing to do fills me with hope for the rest of the game. It was stark how, in just a few minutes of driving from Key Lento, the atmosphere had shifted completely, from road rage to tranquility. The beauty of the place and the amusing conversations to eavesdrop were captivating, even without a weird or wonderful encounter.
That came soon enough.

I placed another waypoint vaguely northeast. It was on the way that I met Tootsie for what was undoubtedly the strangest moment I've had so far in GTA 6. Not only did it imply that animals could talk in this world, or at least psychically communicate, but that Jason could hear them. I wonder if that means anything.

My detour from the main story had been worth it for Tootise (and the $500 from her owner) but it was barely lunchtime. GTA 6's extended day-night cycle feels central to how you play: you can get so much more done in a day than in Red Dead Redemption 2, and even after a languid morning routine of working out and coffee, you're still out the door before 08:00am.

Low on gas, I rolled into a forecourt in Ambrosia, a town where abandoned factories and containers made way for quaint high streets. I was rewarded with another unique scene. A chap with a camo shirt and teeth like a Donegal graveyard spraying gasoline into a bathtub inexplicably mounted in the back of his pickup.

"None of your regulations or mind control is going to stop me!" he shouted as the liquid sloshed down his tailgate, coating the dozen bumper stickers and dripping onto his boots. "I can pump gasoline wherever I want."
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/gta-6-cow-story-fire-1795183518916.jpg

He even sprayed it on Jason, and it took the threat of nearby sirens to hold me back. Thankfully, his cigarette did the work instead, falling and lighting the gas on fire, the flames engulfing his feet. "Those cigarettes'll kill ya man," Jason said, smirking.

Every scripted random encounter so far has felt deliciously crafted. Some funny, some nightmarish. I like that they vary in length and level of interactivity so that when one starts, you never know if it'll trigger an actual quest or just puff into nothingness. I could've just watched the gas station spectacle unfold, like a mini stage play, but hours later when I found a tiger mauling bodies in an abandoned swamp hotel, I had to act.

Later, I ambled a row of cafes and restaurants, got a haircut, ate a protein bar, and threw the protein bar wrapper at a guy who looked at me funny, sparking a seven-person brawl that drew the attention of a cops and – when I gunned one officer down – a police chopper.

I was forced to flee even further north, driving along some railtracks and into the wilderness, not able to stop at the wonderfully named Thrillbully Mud Club. I eventually lost the police chopper and looped back to Ambrosia as the sun dawdled. I wanted to get back by bedtime but I didn't fancy the seven-mile drive back to Key Lento, and as if Rockstar was reading my thoughts, the next corner I rounded revealed a hospital complete with a helipad. I climbed into the cockpit, apologising silently to the next poor sod who needed airlifting to safety, and flew south.

I could have seen this all later in the game. And perhaps I would have gotten more out of it if I'd waited another six hours: I haven't yet done a full robbery, and I'm sure Ambrosia is littered with potential targets. I've only controlled Lucia for one mission, and I'd love to see what happens if both protagonists find something strange together. But the day of distractions, a break from quests, was exactly what I needed, and I was feeling glad that Rockstar doesn't restrict where you can go from the start.

I realise that "go and explore" is not exactly novel advice for a Rockstar open world. But Chapter 1 game encourages you to stay local – I'm saying that you don't need to wait until the story nudges you north. Jump in a car and drive.
Tootsie, I hope we meet again.

items.title: 托比·福克斯 (Toby Fox) 表示，Deltarune 第 6 章“结构上已完成”，而第 7 章的开发工作已开始
items.summary: "All the maps, events and battles exist" for the next slice of the RPG.

content.v: Eight years on since the launch of its first chapter, Deltarune seems to be rapidly approaching completion. With five chapters already released for Toby Fox's sequel to the beloved RPG Undertale , two more are expected before the game is complete. And according to Deltarune creator Toby Box, not only is chapter 6 close to being finished, but work has also already begun on chapter 7.

Fox provided the status update in his most recent newsletter . Kicking off with a general note that chapter 6 is "progressing well", Fox explains that "the game is now a structurally complete draft that can be played from the beginning to the end. He further elaborates that "all the maps, events and battles exist", with the exception of one optional event that's still being worked on.

As a result, the Deltarune team is now at the point where they feel comfortable commencing localisation and preliminary testing. Fox clarifies, however, that full testing won't begin just yet, as "some important scenes and details are still undercooked in their presentation". Indeed, while chapter 6 is progressing rapidly, players shouldn't expect an imminent release. "Even though chapter 6 is a rather short chapter, I would like it to be as good as possible. I won't be able to rush this," Fox points out.

As for Chapter 7, Fox says that development has "only just started". Designers who have finished their Chapter 6 work have moved on to work on the new chapter, while Fox has shared some of the dialogue and events with the Deltarune team. "Just when the story reached a critical moment, I stopped reading. I told my team they need to complete more of the game before I tell them what happens," he explained, adding that "Everyone agrees it's more fun this way."

It's impressive progress, considering that chapter 5 released in June. Then again, development of Deltarune has accelerated rapidly since 2025, when Fox released chapters 3 and 4 of the game in the same year. The launch of chapter 5 also demonstrated just how much fans want to see the story through, as 300,000 concurrent players flocked to Steam to check out the latest chunk of the game.

items.summary: 据玩家在社交平台发帖称，自己因为分享《GTA6》中的大尺度截图，遭到了PlayStation Network（PSN）为期30天的社交功能封禁。

content.v: 据玩家在社交平台发帖称，自己因为分享《GTA6》中的大尺度截图，遭到了PlayStation Network（PSN）为期30天的社交功能封禁。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212107397820.jpg
这名玩家表示，自己在《GTA6》中发现了一处裸体主义者营地，于是使用游戏内相机拍下照片，并通过PSN消息发送给了一位朋友。没想到，这张游戏截图竟然让他收到了长达30天的社交功能禁令。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212107554872.png
需要注意的是，这类内容审核并非PSN独有，Xbox平台同样存在类似限制。玩家即使是在游戏内拍摄的画面，也不意味着可以随意通过主机社交功能分享。尤其是涉及裸体、色情内容的截图，发送前最好先确认平台的内容规范。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212108067126.png
事后，该玩家特意发帖提醒其他人：千万不要通过PSN消息发送包含裸体内容的游戏内照片，否则可能面临类似处罚。

items.title: 外媒喷GTA6男主只会干杂活 没有狠劲不如前几代
items.summary: 近日，海外科技媒体TechDroider发文吐槽《GTA6》的男主角杰森，认为目前公开的内容没有展现出玩家期待中的经典GTA主角形象，反而让…

content.v: 近日，海外科技媒体TechDroider发文吐槽《GTA6》的男主角杰森，认为目前公开的内容没有展现出玩家期待中的经典GTA主角形象，反而让他看起来更像一个忙于处理日常琐事、追求恋爱关系的普通人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212105035814.png
TechDroider表示，杰森不仅要做家务、做饭，还要帮女性角色修理供水设施、处理管道问题、跑腿办事，甚至不断围绕两人的感情关系展开行动。博主认为，这些内容让角色显得缺乏鲜明个性，感情线也没有带来足够的吸引力。
在他看来，玩家期待的是一个能够带来犯罪幻想的GTA主角，而不是在游戏里看角色忙着处理家务。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212105216721.png
TechDroid er 还拿系列前作举例：《GTA：圣安地列斯》通过CJ、帮派文化和街头战争塑造了鲜明的犯罪世界；《GTA：罪恶都市》则以汤米·维赛迪、毒品交易和黑帮权力斗争，呈现出独特的80年代犯罪氛围；《给他爱5》更是通过迈克尔、崔佛和富兰克林三名性格迥异的主角，展现了混乱又充满戏剧性的犯罪生活。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212105299929.png
TechDroider认为，GTA系列一直以来的核心乐趣之一，就是让玩家暂时逃离现实，体验现实生活中无法尝试的犯罪与混乱。相比之下，杰森目前展现出的日常生活和感情戏，让他担心新作会偏离系列以往的风格。
当然，目前TechDroider以及玩家们能够看到的仍只是《GTA6》公开内容的一部分，杰森在完整游戏中的人物塑造和剧情表现，还有待正式体验后才能判断。

content.v: 我们已经看到《GTA6》在没有官方PC版本的情况下也能在PC上运行。需要说明的是，它目前还不是原生运行，但Mod社区似乎很有信心，认为实现这一目标只是时间问题。此前，MOD作者已经成功加入DLSS5，并通过插帧技术将游戏帧率提升至280FPS。如今，又有玩家为《GTA6》加入了第一人称模式，效果看起来相当惊艳。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795257562_660479.jpg

一位X用户分享了一段开启第一人称模式、同时运行DLSS 5的游戏视频，帧率为60FPS。从视频来看，DLSS 5的参数似乎被拉到了极限，人物模型呈现出类似DLSS 5正式发布前早期版本的效果。不过，经过这一技术处理，罪恶城（Vice City）的画面看起来更加逼真，细节表现甚至比原本已经非常出色的游戏画面更加丰富。视频时长超过4分钟，展示了第一人称视角下的自由探索玩法，其中还包含一段水下探索内容。
同一位用户还专门分享了一段水下探索视频，展示了约4分钟的深潜过程。
当然，目前《GTA6》尚未提供官方第一人称模式。至于这一功能是否会通过后续更新加入主机版，还是像《GTA5》一样留到PC版才推出，目前仍不确定。官方至今也没有公布PC版的具体发售时间，不过此前有传闻称，PC版可能会在2027年初推出。

content.v: 被称为“佛罗里达小丑”的劳伦斯·沙利文宣称，自己已作为配音演员参与《GTA6》。Rockstar Games公开的演职员表中，“当地居民”演员名单确实出现了Lawrence Sullivan这一姓名，但官方尚未确认其具体角色，也不能排除同名者的可能。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795255619_527860.jpg
沙利文因面部大量纹身以及2017年在佛罗里达被捕后的照片受到关注。2023年12月，《GTA6》首支预告片公开后，他认为其中一名纹面人物以自己为原型，最初索要200万美元，之后又将金额提高至1000万美元，并曾以诉讼及与黑客合作相威胁。
此后，沙利文改变立场，表示希望亲自为相似角色配音，并扩大该角色的戏份。他近日在Ins发布视频，称自己的声音出现在游戏内社交网络的一段短视频中，相关角色还会与自己的“双胞胎”打斗。
Rockstar Games目前没有确认沙利文对角色和场景的描述。现有资料也未披露他是否获得补偿，以及双方是否达成合作、具体条件为何。

items.summary: 《GTA6》的女性角色中，你心目中的《GTA6》第一美女是谁？

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA6》的女性角色中， 你心目中的《GTA6》第一美女是谁？
外媒FandomWire评选出了《GTA6》中最性感的六位女性角色。最近人气暴涨的曼迪虽然成功跻身榜单，但最终只排在第二名，主角露西亚则拿下第一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212034056354.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212034097295.webp
此次榜单中，第六名是Petra Navarro，第五名是露西亚的母亲Mia Caminos，第四名为Real Dimez组合成员Roxy Rashad，第三名则是她的搭档Bae-Luxe。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212034181203.webp
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212034222333.webp
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212034242752.webp
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212034284467.webp
第二名曼迪无疑是本次榜单的一大焦点。她在游戏第一章中登场，Jason上门收租时与其相遇。曼迪身穿性感比基尼，不仅主动向Jason调情，妩媚的声音和大胆的表现也让她迅速走红，甚至一度成为玩家讨论的热门角色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212035144072.png
不过，榜首最终还是由女主角露西亚拿下。媒体认为，她不仅拥有出众的外形，还兼具坚韧、力量与个人魅力。文章还特别提到，露西亚与Jason之间的忠诚关系也是她的魅力所在。最终，露西亚凭借更多的出场时间战胜曼迪，登上榜首。
这个排名你满意吗？你觉得露西亚该不该拿下第一？

items.title: GTA6最胖体型玩家仍不满足！越胖露西娅丰臀越大？
items.summary: 据TheGamer报道，已有《GTA6》玩家在24小时内把角色的健身与体重数值刷到极限，试图让主角杰森和露西亚尽可能丰满，结果却引来一片…

content.v: 据TheGamer报道，已有《GTA6》玩家在24小时内把角色的健身与体重数值刷到极限，试图让主角杰森和露西亚尽可能丰满，结果却引来一片“不够胖”的抱怨。
报道称，Reddit用户TheKey32晒出了自己最大体重、低肌肉的杰森。截图里的杰森出现了双下巴的迹象，衬衫下也透出一点肥胖身材，但整体仍显得结实。帖子下很快有人喊话，希望把他做得更胖，有玩家甚至调侃想让杰森胖到需要代步车才能行动。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469291.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469292.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469293.jpg
Reddit的讨论大多集中在杰森身上，推特上的玩家则更多盯着露西亚。有用户认为，最大体重的露西亚仍能看到腹肌轮廓和锁骨，不像低肌肉的状态；也有人直接表达失望，觉得这已经是上限却仍达不到预期。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469295.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469296.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469297.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469298.jpg
不少玩家拿《圣安地列斯》里的CJ作对比，认为那才是他们期待的体型变化幅度。对熟悉系列的老玩家来说，体重系统能不能明显改变角色外观，本身就是角色自定义真实感的一部分。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/21/cas_auto/small_0_9469306.jpg
这场吐槽还顺带带火了PC版的话题。报道提到，一些玩家表示等PC版上线后，第一件事就是用Mod把主角改成XXL体型。对《GTA 6》来说，发售初期的这类社区讨论，也在提前勾勒玩家对后续自定义与Mod生态的期待。

items.title: GTA 6 玩家遇到的 NPC 反击得如此激烈，你可能应该别管他们
items.summary: Just like in real life, there are some people you really shouldn’t mess with in GTA 6. It’s not always easy to

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/21/gtavi-56-1795263173286.jpg
Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 follow.
Just like in real life, there are some people you really shouldn’t mess with in GTA 6 . It’s not always easy to tell at a glance either. Books, covers, and all that.

GTA 6 has a wild range of NPCs with unpredictable and unique behavior — you never know what you’re gonna get. Players have been documenting their adventures across Leonida and their interactions with the locals, and have come across the weird, the funny, and the downright scary.
Not only do some NPCs fight back, but they fight hard and can take more punches to the head than Rocky. Some of them even bring little friends along to the throwdown.

The viral clip below, from @WIZZYGM , shows Lucia attempting to take someone’s car. Instead of allowing themselves to be dragged out, however, they got psyched up about having a tussle. They were into it.

Not only did they take a ridiculous number of punches directly to the nose, but at one point they even gave Lucia some free shots. Then they banged some powder up their snout and Hulked out. He even took a gunshot straight to the head!
Nah this Npc’s got it 🔥🔥🔥 #GTAVI #GTA6 #ViceCity. https://t.co/KzQt4zJOsf
“I appreciate that the NPCs in this game act like true Floridians,” read one reply . “Bro said ‘I can run faster than you can drive’ nah son im turning the game off lmfaooooo,” said another .

In another clip, from @chrisdadeviant , Jason attempts to hijack a car but the person inside had a massive meltdown and started headbutting the steering wheel, honking the horn with each forehead slam. Eventually, she got out and threatened to stomp Jason’s teeth out of his head.
Jason ignored the temper tantrum and got in the car anyway, and she tried to pull him out before he drove away. Here’s the clip for that one:
😭😭😭😭😭😭😭 https://t.co/LbY0AwEJbZ
“This is such a valid crashout lmaooooooooo,” said one fan . “Yea just let her keep the car, she clearly going through something,” another joked .

One clip going around is downright terrifying. The player, having found a sniper rifle at the top of a tower, wanted to test their aim. They looked through the scope at an NPC, took aim, and fired a shot directly at their chest.

Instead of falling over, the NPC started walking towards the tower. Blood pooled on their clothing where the bullet landed, more shots rang out and landed right on target, and they kept coming, tucking their drinks under the arm and breaking into a full sprint.
On the way, they were hit by a car and shot multiple times. There was a trail of blood marking out their route, but they just kept coming.

SNIPER'S PARADISE: This GTA 6 rooftop clip shows NPCs reacting so unrealistically to random hits that fans are calling them straight-up Terminators. ✘ shit you only see in florida, I guess https://t.co/gl72UrXzvT

A similar clip showed a player sniping an NPC. The NPC saw them aiming and mimicked a slice across the neck with their thumb, before tanking bullets and sprinting at the player. Eventually, they teleported behind the player and attacked.
THIS GTA 6 NPC CAN SOMEHOW SPOT YOU AND TELEPORT BEHIND YOU TO ONE-SHOT YOU 😳💀 #GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA https://t.co/37CC1K0akr

It’s not just people you have to watch out for either. In one clip, a player hijacked a car, thought they were safe, and then heard noises from behind them. It was the vehicle’s owner’s cat in the back seat, which jump-scared them and savaged them with claws and teeth.
In GTA 6, Jason steals a man’s car with a cat in the backseat. While driving, the cat jumps on him, and he throws it out of the car before continuing to drive. https://t.co/MoJQCqUFje
“Nah I’m sold this is crazy I can’t wait to play,” said one reply . “Best game of all time bro,” another posted .

Clearly, Rockstar has tuned some NPCs to give the player a hard time, so keep your wits about you! If you're interested in how Rockstar made the game feel so alive, we have comments direct from the GTA 6 development team on the creation of its many NPCs .

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

items.title: 管泽元玩GTA6玩爽了 坐出租车刷手机都很有意思
items.summary: 近日，LPL知名解说管泽元发文分享了自己游玩《GTA6》的感受，直言这款游戏让他玩得十分尽兴。

content.v: 近日，LPL知名解说管泽元发文分享了自己游玩《GTA6》的感受，直言这款游戏让他玩得十分尽兴。
管泽元表示，《GTA6》继《荒野大镖客2》之后，再一次满足了自己想要“在游戏里过日子”的需求。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212001443302.png
他还举了一个很有意思的例子：自己在游戏里打车后，坐在后座一路刷着游戏内的手机，竟然也觉得很有意思。在他看来，能让玩家连这种日常活动都乐在其中的游戏，目前相当少见。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212003094625.png
管泽元此前曾多次表达自己对单主机游戏的喜爱。他尤其偏爱《荒野大镖客2》《夺宝奇兵：古老之圈》这类强调剧情、注重沉浸感的作品。相比单纯追求快速通关，他更享受深入游戏世界、体验角色生活的过程。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212005512854.png
从这次分享来看，《GTA6》显然也正好满足了管泽元的这一偏好。对他而言，游戏的乐趣不仅来自任务和战斗，就连乘车途中刷手机这样的细节，也足以成为沉浸体验的一部分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611212006028208.png

others.title: 《GTA6》Metacritic遭差评轰炸 玩家评分仅5.4分

content.v: 虽然《GTA6》获得国外媒体的一致好评，包括IGN，GameSpot在内的媒体都给出了10分满分好评，然而在社交媒体上却是另外一番景象。不少玩家吐槽《GTA6》变成“女性人生模拟器”，男主角地位太弱，女主太丑等问题，没有了往日的GTA味。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795256584_186496_jpg_r.jpg
近日《GTA6》的MTC玩家评分出炉，和社交媒体上玩家的反馈一致，大量游戏玩家给出了自己的真实评测。大量玩家给《GTA6》打分0分，也就是说《GTA6》在MTC上遭到了差评轰炸。
不少玩家认为《GTA6》充斥着无聊的跑腿任务和琐碎事务，游戏节奏拖沓，缺乏过去《GTA》系列那种自由、疯狂的感觉，反而更像一款恋爱模拟器。
部分玩家甚至直言，耗费13年开发时间和巨额预算，最终却交出这样一款作品，堪称近十年来游戏行业最大的失望。
除此之外，关于主角塑造、剧情方向、游戏BUG以及未来线上模式可能存在的氪金问题，也成为玩家集中批评的对象。显然，尽管《GTA6》在媒体评价中取得了近乎完美的成绩，但对于普通玩家而言，这款作品并没有真正满足所有人的期待。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795233817_232733_jpg_r.jpg
MTC玩家评分5.4分
正面评价：
这绝对是史上最佳游戏！！！好多黑子只想挑刺，所以我来写个好评。我敢肯定他们大多数人根本没玩过。
典型的Rockstar风格！只有Rockstar才能突破自我！史上最佳游戏！年度最佳游戏！
现在到处都是些没脑子的评论，说这游戏“也就那样”。这游戏很有创新性，对RDR2机制的改进和完善简直棒极了。第一章节奏确实比较慢，但之后就精彩纷呈了。强烈推荐。年度最佳游戏！这 绝对是我玩过的最佳游戏之一。NPC和游戏世界都非常棒，说实话，我都没注意到只有30帧。这游戏太棒了，你一定要试试。Rockstar 在这款游戏上做得非常出色，画面也美极了。迫不及待想看看他们接下来的作品。
哇！根本停不下来！这款游戏拥有精彩的故事和惊险刺激的动作场面！它完美地展现了游戏玩法、画面、疫情历史以及疫情发展历程的史诗级演变。这是

我玩过的最棒的游戏。游戏氛围、沉浸感和系统——游戏的方方面面都打磨得非常精细，莱昂尼达的世界栩栩如生。这是剧情最棒的GTA。侠盗猎车手VI是一款品质极高的作品，完美地满足了我发售前的所有期待。它 在各个方面都具有突破性意义。它是史上最佳游戏之一，甚至可能是史上最佳游戏。从技术层面来说，它领先于其他任何游戏数年。那些抱怨帧率的人根本不知道Rockstar在这里取得了怎样的成就。这是一款你绝对不能错过的游戏。我已经
玩了20个小时了。它是我玩过的最棒的游戏之一。时隔这么久，我终于找到了一款真正让我享受的游戏，我感到非常高兴。感谢Rockstar一直以来对电子游戏行业的支持。
负面评价：
哦，这等待真是值得。无聊透顶的琐事，琐事，琐事。大家都知道为什么。
任何给这破游戏打两星以上的人都不配玩游戏。这不是GTA，这只是个简单的模拟器，一个简化版。
说实话，它开发了13年都没完成。预算可能被挪用了，所以我只能祈祷GTA7别发售。而且，线上模式很可能又是另一个靠鲨鱼卡赚钱的氪金游戏，而且会更糟糕，因为他们会从第一天就给你一大堆。能跑就跑。哦，编剧们肯定犯罪剧看多了。
13年前的每个事件里都会出现各种各样的bug，而且会持续13年。
真不敢相信他们花了这么多钱就做了个这么个蹩脚又无聊的恋爱模拟器！它毁掉了之前GTA游戏里那种自由的感觉。这简直就是教人如何当“好男友”的课，一点也不好玩！所有主角都无聊透顶，毫无灵魂！花了
13年就为了这个?这绝对是近十年游戏界最大的败笔。
你不是在享受游戏乐趣，而是被迫做家务和跑腿。真是革命性的。烂透了。
它应该从一开始就登陆PC平台。这种游戏怎么能只在儿童游戏机上发布?
这游戏简直是女权主义幻想的失败之作。它既不适合男性也不适合女性。它是为社会无缘无故容忍的那1%的精神病患者准备的。你不是在享受游戏，而是在忍受这坨屎。赶紧把写这游戏的人炒了。
啊，真是值得等待。无聊，无聊的家务，家务，家务。每个人都知道为什么。
任何给这坨屎打分超过2分的人都不配玩电子游戏。这根本不是GTA，它只是个简单的模拟器，一个简化版。
说实话，它已经开发了13年了。预算可能被挪用了，所以我们只能祈祷GTA7别发售。而且，线上模式很可能又是另一个靠鲨鱼卡赚钱的氪金游戏，而且会更糟，因为他们会从第一天就给你一大堆。能跑就跑吧。哦，对了，编剧们肯定是犯罪剧看多了。
这游戏的bug多到从13年前到最近13年的每个事件里都有。
真不敢相信他们花了这么多钱就做了个这么个蹩脚又无聊的恋爱模拟器！它完全毁掉了之前GTA游戏里那种自由的感觉。这简直就是教你如何做一个“好男友”的讲座，一点也不好玩！所有主角都无聊、乏味、毫无灵魂！
这游戏真的花了13年才做出来吗?这一定是近十年来游戏行业最大的败笔。

items.title: 管泽元自称不敢碰BLG冠军奖杯 一不小心就天价赔偿
items.summary: 近日，LPL知名解说管泽元发文分享了自己与BLG冠军奖杯的趣事。

content.v: 近日，LPL知名解说管泽元发文分享了自己与BLG冠军奖杯的趣事。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211951415731.png
他表示，本来想捧一下奖杯，但听说万一不小心磕碰，可能需要支付天价赔偿，最终还是“颤抖地缩回了双手”。他还感谢了BLG方面的支持，并表示希望大家期待后续节目。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211951496736.png
此前，管泽元曾因个人视频中出现涉及BLG上单选手Bin的相关黑梗而陷入舆论争议。尽管管泽元本人曾解释称自己绝无冒犯之意，但相关讨论仍持续了一段时间。

items.title: Rockstar 如何让 GTA 6 中的每个 NPC 都充满活力
items.summary: Rockstar made NPCs feel alive in GTA 6 by "establishing deep backstories for almost everything" throughout Leo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/illegal-ops1-1795093051042.jpg

Game developers often refer to their open world cities as characters due to the sheer craftsmanship involved in building out a believable, diverse playspace for the player with its own districts, history, and architecture. This is truer for GTA 6 than most games, but what makes Leonida really feel alive — outside of the puddles of bin juice, the regional-specific cop cars, and mapped out power grid — are the people who live there.

GTA 6 feels like a massive evolution in what it means to be a non-player character (NPC) because there’s an emphasis on the “C” — they’re actually characters in their own right. NPCs don’t just all look unique — with body types, skin, dress style, and hair making them stand apart — they have their own personalities and temperaments. Start a fight with one NPC and they might fight back, while another runs away. One could start a fight by slapping you, another might flick their cigarette at you or tip their drink over your head. Passersby can cheer the fight on, flee, or get involved. Some stop after a single punch knocks sense into them, while others swing until they’re out cold .

No matter where you go in GTA 6, it feels like a lived-in world, on the macro and micro scale. There are over 100 interiors to explore, and each house tells you a story about its occupants. Listen to conversations out on the streets and you’ll get a window into their minds, built out by an entire Rockstar studio dedicated to making them authentic and believable, while still being larger-than-life, funny, and often unhinged.

“A big part of it was establishing deep backstories for almost everything, even if they were never meant to be fully explained to the player, and then really sticking to those backstories,” said Steven Messinger, Rockstar's senior design director for the open world. “For example, our gang compounds have a complex drug network we’ve fully mapped out: where the drugs come from, who brings them in and how, how they’re distributed to each compound, what happens at each stop, and how they eventually reach the street-level buyer.

“Players will only pick up on bits and pieces of this, but having that structure in the background as something we consistently refer to helps everything feel more real, like this big machine is always running even when players aren’t there.”

To build this tangible sense of place, Rockstar takes in-depth research trips for GTA games , embedding the writers in the mundane and the more extreme to really capture the soul of a city. Helicopter trips of the Florida Keys, ride-alongs with police, talking to people, taking photos and notes, all build up a snapshot that Rockstar bottles up to digitize in video game format.

“We had a lot of fun trying to capture the raw energy and vibrant chaos that Florida is known for,” said senior design director of world and population, John Macpherson. “By immersing ourselves into a number of these locations on reference trips, spending time with locals, experiencing as much as possible firsthand, we gathered a direct sense of what would make Leonida feel truly alive.

“Everywhere you look, little stories constantly unfold. It could be as simple as what someone’s wearing, how fit they are, how they walk and talk, who they’re with, what tunes they’re blasting as they cruise down the street. We tried to match that in-game as much as possible, hopefully resulting in something that feels full of life.”

You can walk along Vice Beach and see sugar daddies with their trophy wives, locals playing volleyball, tourists sunbathing, and people walking their pets. Everywhere you look, there’s something happening in Leonida, and it’s completely enveloping. You feel like a part of its world, rather than a godlike being with total control over it.

There’s a mission around the midpoint of the game where protagonists Jason and Lucia people-watch from a hotel sunbed, inventing backstories for the guests by the pool, and it’s something I found myself doing as I explored the world and passed people by, such is the variety and diversity of the game’s NPCs. No other game has ever had such a colorful cast of extras, which is wild when you consider all this was built to add credibility to a world you can zoom past at 100mph.

“We evolved from monolithic NPCs built to visual standards that were lower than the main cast in GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2, to fully fleshed-out characters with singular awareness and visual identities,” said Valmor Garcia, senior technical art director on GTA 6. “They are driven by dynamic moods, personalities, unique anatomy, facial features, and dialogue that are visually on par with our protagonists, Jason and Lucia.”

Rockstar built entirely new technology for GTA 6 to simulate hair, cloth, and the way muscles move under the skin. All that work is implemented equally across all characters, so there’s never that uncanny moment where you come face-to-face with a flat and lifeless NPC, staring at you with dead eyes. Everyone you meet is equally detailed, and the range of visual design is staggering.

Of course, this approach created challenges in other areas of development. It’s fairly straightforward to implement a combat system in a game where all character models are approximately the same size, but the varied body types of GTA 6 meant Rockstar had to take a look at how it approached animations so physical contact looks good no matter how big or small the character models are. Especially since this is a game where the two leads can also change in size through diet and exercise .

“We decided early on that we wanted to really push the variation in character sizes and body types,” vice president of animation, Mark Tennant, explained. “This required us to establish a very robust way to share animations between characters while still resolving multiple points of contact, such as most vehicle interactions and grappling in hand-to-hand combat.

“Developing this workflow meant that we needed our animators to adopt new techniques compared to a more traditional approach. We also had to grow a team dedicated to overseeing the implementation, which required close collaboration with the art and rigging teams. All these aspects needed to come together to make it work, so it was a huge team effort.”

It wasn’t just player-on-NPC contact that needed to be considered either. There are dozens and dozens of scripted scenes dotted about Leonida to find, the usual Strangers and Freaks of Rockstar games weaved into the fabric of the world, manifesting as wacky encounters of various size and scope. Some are one-on-one, but sometimes you become a spectator as two NPCs with opposing goals clash. If you decide to intervene, the game has to account for every possible permutation of that.

“Shifting the centre of action off the player at times required a lot of careful thought too — if a cop is doing a stop-and-search on another criminal in the world, how do they behave if you commit a crime in front of them?” vice president of design Stephen Donkin explained. “Do they switch their attention to you? Do they compare the severity of the crime? If they come after you, what does the original criminal do? Does he drive off? What happens if you follow him?

items.title: 《Expedition 33》的主要作者表示，《侠盗猎车手 6》的裁员担忧表明“创造价值的人并未获得相应的价值”
items.summary: "I sincerely hope the Rockstar team is successful in unionizing".

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 is already enormously successful, having enjoyed "the biggest entertainment launch in history" . But the current games industry is such that some Rockstar developers are still concerned about being laid off in the wake of its release. Writing for the Guardian prior to GTA 6's launch, Rockstar animation programmer Nestor Uriarte explained that although there is "no indication that layoffs are coming" it nonetheless "says a lot about the industry that even my colleagues and I, working on the biggest game of all time, are worried about getting laid off."

It might sound odd for the developers of such a hugely successful game to be worried about losing their jobs, but layoffs don't just occur when games or companies struggle commercially. A common cause of layoffs in the games industry is companies trying to reduce overheads after a game has launched, as the studio switches from full production to post-release support for their current game and planning for the next one.

It's partly why the industry seems to be in a constant, rolling state of layoffs, even when games appear to sell well. This issue was recently addressed by Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, the lead writer of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 . Svedberg-Yen, who left Sandfall Interactive in July , claimed that the problem is exacerbated by an imbalance in who benefits financially when a game like Grand Theft Auto 6 launches.

"99 Metacritic score. Multiple award nominations before it even released. Massive sales and player engagement. Incredible amounts of tangible and intangible value creation. Yet the team is worried about layoffs," Svedberg-Yen wrote in an Instagram post. "So, who receives the lion's share of the profits from their labor? Not the vast majority of the creative team."

Svedberg-Yen pointed out that this is "one of the issues that happens when the people creating the value do not receive a proportionate amount of that value," adding that "In finance, we call that value extraction."

Svedberg-Yen also commented on the Rockstar team's ongoing efforts to unionise, with the team in the process of voting on whether or not it wants a union. If successful, the Rockstar Game Workers Union would become the biggest in the UK's gaming sector.

"I sincerely hope the Rockstar team is successful in unionizing," Svedberg-Yen wrote. "Layoffs during lulls in development cycles would work a lot better if teams were properly paid for the value they create, not just one-time, but throughout the life of the thing they created."

The games industry has seen a huge number of layoffs in the last few years. A recent report by GDC found that 34% of developers it surveyed had been laid off since 2024. Xbox alone has cut thousands of jobs , with more planned going into January 2027. Most recently, Firaxis, owned by GTA 6 publisher Take Two Interactive, reportedly laid off a third of its staff earlier this week as it works on a new XCOM.

items.title: 《GTA6》Xbox代码泄露 PC移植版或一周内完成
items.summary: 在《GTA6》发售当天，黑客Cyberleek泄露了Xbox版本的大量代码，这可能为非官方PC移植铺平道路。这一过程被称为“重新编译”，即调整游戏代码使其能够在其他平台上运行。Cyberleek认为，玩家可以在一周内让游

content.v: 在《GTA6》发售当天，黑客Cyberleek泄露了Xbox版本的大量代码，这可能为非官方PC移植铺平道路。这一过程被称为“重新编译”，即调整游戏代码使其能够在其他平台上运行。Cyberleek认为，玩家可以在一周内让游戏在PC上运行。尽管这种泄露行为可能会对游戏开发商造成利益损害，但这位颇具争议的黑客在Reddit上却获得了大量支持。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261121/1795256356_186841.webp

PC玩家显然对等待《GTA6》感到焦躁不安。然而，玩家们对即将推出的非官方PC版的热情，似乎主要源于对Rockstar长期以来先在主机平台发售游戏，后在PC平台发布的策略的不满。许多玩家指责Rockstar故意诱导玩家购买同一款游戏两次。那些渴望在游戏发售时就玩到《GTA6》的玩家可能会先购买主机版，之后再购买PC版以体验更精美的画面。一些玩家甚至公开表示他们打算玩非官方移植版。另一些人则希望，非官方移植版的快速开发能够给R星施加压力，促使其提前发布官方PC版。
非官方移植版能否在下周真正运行仍是未知数。模组制作者们仍然缺少一个关键文件：游戏的可执行文件（EXE），没有它游戏就无法启动。

Cyberleek表示他计划在11月23日发布，但这是否足以如此迅速地制作出一个可运行的PC版本还有待观察。此外，人们也对这种重新编译可能带来的后果感到担忧。如果新发布的游戏在发售后不久就免费出现在其他平台上，开发商可能会损失宝贵的收入。对于小型工作室而言，这些损失尤其可能危及它们的生存。长此以往，这可能会使新游戏的开发更加困难，并促使发行商引入更严格的始终在线要求——最终，玩家的体验也会因此而受损。

items.summary: 近日，霍建华为宣传新剧《急诊室的奇迹》，登上Netflix官方YouTube节目，接受一系列快问快答。面对“是否已经过气”的提问，他幽默…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211848566580.png
近日，霍建华为宣传新剧《急诊室的奇迹》，登上Netflix官方YouTube节目，接受一系列快问快答。面对“是否已经过气”的提问，他幽默回应：“我有红过吗？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211848586553.png
霍建华透露，过去拍戏时对作品要求很高，曾抱着“一出手就要拿收视冠军”的决心。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211849078466.png
工作最忙的时候，他每天甚至只睡约3个小时，武打戏和文言文台词也尽可能亲自完成。如今，他的生活节奏则放缓不少，通常晚上七八点就休息。
对于人气起伏，霍建华表示，曾经在餐厅遇到一家人为祖母庆生，对方因为祖母喜欢看他的电视剧而主动找他合影。这件事让他颇有感触。他认为，过去的粉丝如今成为长期支持自己的观众，观众年龄层还能横跨不同世代，是自己最骄傲、也最珍惜的事情。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211849164858.png
《急诊室的奇迹》共8集，于11月12日在Netflix全球上线。霍建华在剧中饰演急诊室资深医生周承俊，与杨谨华饰演的主治医生何宇华，以及蔡凡熙等演员共同出演。
剧集上线不到48小时便登上Netflix中国台湾日榜冠军，随后又拿下周榜第一，同时进入中国香港和泰国榜单前五名。
出道二十多年来，霍建华曾凭借《仙剑奇侠传三》《花千骨》《如懿传》等作品打开了知名度，如今他减少了作品产量，逐渐将重心转向写实题材。《急诊室的奇迹》上线后在多个地区榜单取得成绩，也让这位曾经的古装剧男神再次受到关注。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261121/BktRQBbuhDmnFzs.png!a-3-480x.png
据报道，Macaulay Culkin 已签约在迪士尼制作的《小鬼当家》新续集中回归饰演 Kevin McCallister。
关于这位初代童星回归该系列的消息最初由 Puck 报道。该项目据称正处于迪士尼的早期开发阶段，Culkin 将再次饰演影史上最顽皮的角色之一，且已有其他知名人士参与其中。
参与其中的人才阵容包括《The Studio》和《这就是末日》的合作伙伴 Evan Goldberg 和 Seth Rogen。这对喜剧搭档已通过他们的 Point Grey 旗号签约制作《小鬼当家》续集，并将协助 Culkin 敲定电影剧情的细节。
自 Culkin 在 90 年代助力开启这一经典圣诞系列电影以来，已经推出了多部《小鬼当家》续集，但大多数人都认为 McCallister 家族的故事很难被超越。只有原作电影及其《小鬼当家2：玩转纽约》续集成功捕捉到了那种让观众数十年来趋之若鹜的节日魔力，而这很大程度上要归功于 Culkin 的表演。

这位如今已成年的演员一直是《小鬼当家》名副其实的代言人。在 2026 年，他不仅准备好回归饰演 Kevin，而且显然这个点子还是他自己提出的。Deadline 证实了 Puck 的报道，并详细说明了 Culkin 的参与程度。据称，这位明星在夏天向迪士尼影业负责人 David Greenbaum 提出了他回归《小鬼当家》的想法。一个早期的构思是让 Kevin 以一个更年长、更睿智的形象重返大银幕，而他现在恰好也当了爸爸。
Kevin 是会把自己的孩子忘在家里，还是会再次亲自对付窃贼，目前尚不得而知，也不清楚 Culkin 早期构思中的内容有多少会进入最终成片。距离这位明星最后一次（正式）扮演被遗弃的 McCallister 男孩已经过去了 34 年，因此，如果这部处于开发早期的电影最终问世，将为粉丝们长达数十年的回归诉求画上句号。
Culkin 回归饰演 Kevin 将标志着他第三次出演该角色，也是该系列的第七部作品。上一部作品是 2021 年首映的 Disney+ 独占电影《新小鬼当家》，由 Archie Yates、Ellie Kemper 和 Rob Delaney 主演。该片被评价为“包含了机智与真情，尽管也存在传达信息笨拙和某些基调失误的问题”。
此外，你还可以关注 Culkin 辩称《虎胆龙威》不是圣诞电影的立场。你还可以了解到原版导演 Chris Columbus 显然并不喜欢那些续集。

items.title: 黑客急着公开《GTA6》最终exe文件 下调"圈钱"目标
items.summary: 据playground报道，知名黑客“葱哥”CYBERLEEK宣布，下调了其个人加密货币的市值目标。

content.v: 据playground报道，知名黑客“葱哥”CYBERLEEK宣布，下调了其个人加密货币的市值目标。此前，他要求该加密货币市值达到1500万美元才会提前公开《GTA6》游戏文件，如今这一门槛已降至600万美元。目前，该加密货币的市值约为150万美元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211822536414.png
CYBERLEEK表示，如果市值达到目标，他就会公开Xbox Series版本《GTA6》的可执行文件（EXE）。这份文件可用于Xbox模拟器，也可能成为制作非官方PC移植版的基础。
不过，即使最终未能达到600万美元的目标，他仍承诺会在11月23日公开该文件。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/21/small_202611211822471321.png
